description.message: Switches the keyboard layout by website. Sends only the active tab's domain to the Keyboard Switcher app on this computer.

optionsIntro.message: Port of the Keyboard Switcher app (same as in the app, default 47863).

optionsNotApp.message: Something else answers on this port.

optionsNotRunning.message: Keyboard Switcher is not running or uses another port.
